evals.prompt: Implement a Compose watchlist screen from this Figma frame: list of instruments with price and change, a search field, and on tablets a detail pane on the right. Our theme is BridgeTheme with tokens mapped to MaterialTheme.
evals.expected_output: Compose code using BridgeTheme/MaterialTheme roles, hoisted state, a list-detail layout driven by window size class, edge-to-edge insets and imePadding for the search field, semantics for price change (not color only), previews for dark, font scale 2.0, RTL and expanded width, and a pointer to the official adaptive skill.
assertions: Layout changes based on window size class
No raw Color(0x...) values in components
Price change is conveyed by text or semantics, not color alone
Previews include large font scale and RTL
